profile.name: Igor Bykov
profile.headline: Full stack software engineer
profile.summary: I like to tackle complex problems, take ownership, make things work, constantly learn, share my experience & always strive to find an effective solution for every problem. From my very first line of code to right now, I've always been driven by curiosity, fascinated by the incredible things technology enables & eager to constantly learn and grow.
personality: Always ready to both learn & share knowledge

The newly formed squad I led was responsible for checkout, payment processing & payouts, and subsequently got heavily involved in major integration- & AI-based features development.

Ran a large, AI-assisted refactor of the BDD test suite, fixing most sources of flakiness & decreasing false-positive CI failures by 70%
Architected an Algolia integration that significantly improved search UX & introduced search analytics that increased sales by 4% per platform on average

Onboarded 5 new members of the team & mentored 3 engineers
